regions.merged_text: Ellen Reilly Stephens 2022-3rd Ave. Married two weeks ago in City Hall, refuses to have marriage fixed up. Mother's heart broken, family upset; sister in anxiety enrolls pair Today March 12 they come to monastery of own accord at 8:45P.M. and make all arrange- ments for and promises for dispensation and are married cannoni- cally shortly after. - April 2nd Deo Gratias
